reasoning_traces.think:
The reasoning engine's core failure lies in disconnected input/output paths. Static fixture inputs (SFRI) decouple from live game states (LGSI), rendering causal inference non-responsive. The closed signal tilt seam (CSTS) blocks probabilistic updates via environmental signals, enforcing a deterministic trueProb. Orphaned adversary verdicts (OAV) create isolated critiques that do not influence pick generation. These primitives form a triadic failure mode: static input → closed feedback → discarded critique. The system's epistemic closure prevents real-time adaptation, making it a static trace rather than a dynamic reasoning loop. The absence of signal-to-probability mapping creates a vacuum where predictions are not updated by incoming data, violating the principle of continuous calibration.
